description: 🆕 A MetaMorpho vault spreads your deposit across Morpho Blue markets — your real risk is WHERE the curator put it and WHO can move it. Reads the vault's live allocation (concentration, per-market collateral + liquidation LTV), idle share, performance fee, timelock, and control (curator/owner/guardian, and whether one address holds both). Returns a diversified / concentrated / control_risk verdict: the read before parking funds in a yield vault. vault= required. Not financial advice.
